Settings.appDescription: The most professional way to manage your business cheques.
Settings.faq1Q: How do I add a new business?
Settings.faq1A: Go to Settings > My Businesses and click on the 'Add Business' button.
Settings.faq2A: Yes, you can export all your cheques to a CSV file from Settings > Data & Reports.
Settings.faq3Q: What happens if a cheque bounces?
Settings.faq3A: You can update the status of any cheque to 'Bounced' from the cheque detail page.
Settings.privacyIntroContent: Welcome to ChequeCheck. We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our application.
Settings.privacyDataCollectContent: We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as your name, email address, and business details. We also collect data related to your cheques, accounts, and parties to provide our services.
Settings.privacyHowUseContent: Your data is used solely to provide and improve the ChequeCheck service, including managing your cheques, sending reminders, and providing reports. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
Settings.privacyDataSecurityContent: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. Your information is stored securely using Supabase and is encrypted where appropriate.
Settings.privacyYourRightsContent: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data at any time. You can manage your information directly within the app settings.
Settings.privacyContactUsContent: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at support@chequecheck.com.
Settings.refundSubRefundsContent: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee for all new subscriptions. If you are not satisfied with ChequeCheck, you can request a full refund within 7 days of your initial purchase.
Settings.refundHowRequestContent: To request a refund, please email us at support@chequecheck.com with your account details and the reason for your request. We process refunds within 5-10 business days.
Settings.refundExceptionsContent: Refunds are not available for monthly renewals unless requested within 24 hours of the charge. We do not provide partial refunds for unused portions of a subscription month or year.
Settings.refundTrialPeriodsContent: New users may be eligible for a free trial period. No charges will be made during the trial period, and you can cancel at any time.
Settings.termsAcceptanceContent: By accessing or using ChequeCheck, you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, you may not use the application.
Settings.termsUseLicenseContent: We grant you a personal, non-transferable license to use ChequeCheck for your personal or business cheque management purposes. You may not reverse engineer, decompile, or attempt to extract the source code of the app.
Settings.termsAccountRespContent: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You agree to accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account.
Settings.termsLiabilityContent: ChequeCheck is provided "as is" without any warranties. We shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from the use or inability to use the service.
Settings.termsChangesToTermsContent: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify users of any significant changes by posting the new terms within the application.

Settings.launchFeat2Desc: Switch between multiple businesses and manage their accounts.
